name: Motorcycle
description: Any motor-operated vehicle of the bicycle or tricycle type with a saddle or seat the rider sits astride or a platform to stand on, a definition that also takes in mopeds. Since the moped definition caps only combustion engines, the statute draws no power or speed line between an electric moped and an electric motorcycle, though it sets a registration fee for battery-electric motorcycles.

restrictions.rule: A motor-operated vehicle of the bicycle or tricycle type with a saddle, seat or standing platform; excludes electric bicycles
No limit on motor power or speed
Riders need a driver's license certified by a state testing officer for motorcycles; an approved motorcycle safety course can waive the test
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a DOT motorcycle helmet
Riders must wear eye protection unless it has an adequate windscreen
Titled and registered, at the top motorcycle fee ($24) for a battery-electric one, and must carry liability insurance
Kept to the normally traveled roads or designated areas in municipal, county and state parks and recreation areas
An off-road electric dirt bike is an off-road vehicle and can't be plated as a motorcycle, since only combustion off-road two-wheelers of 120 cc or more may be
